title: nerve-wml v1.9.0: Substrate-Agnostic Nerve Protocol — External-Review Response, SpikingKiki Substrate, EWC Hardening, Full-LIF L1a
description: v1.9.0 release answers two external reviewer critiques with merged work, two ADRs, and a lockstep paper requalification. Key additions since v1.8.1: (1) bias-corrected MI (Panzeri–Treves estimator + permutation null, ADR-0001) — the MI/H figure survives debiasing (0.931) and the permutation null (~0.005, p<0.01) but is requalified as post-VQ; pre-VQ KSG gives 0.095; (2) prior-art novelty reframing (ADR-0002) — cross-architecture convergence conceded as prior art (Moschella 2022 / PRH); nerve-wml contribution delimited to discrete protocol-output measurement on MLP/LIF/Transformer; (3) SpikingKikiWML conformant substrate scaffold + MmapNpzProvider + SpikingKikiBioClient + SpikingKikiBlockProvider Protocol (#37–#43); (4) EWC hardening — diagonal Fisher EWC vs honest rehearsal comparison (track_w/continual/ewc.py + rehearsal.py, #46/#47); (5) L1a Full-LIF sim training + scaling sweep (#48); (6) track-p role out-of-band 2-channel carrier (#45). The v1.8.0 axioms-axis integration (DR-0..DR-4 frozen Axiom dataclasses, GammaThetaMultiplexer) and all prior gates remain valid.
